name: Products / 产品
description: Every product the team builds: who owns it and which repositories carry it. / 团队在做的每个产品：谁负责、由哪些代码仓库承载。

label.en: Register a new product and its repositories
label.zh-CN: 登记一个新产品和它的代码仓库

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-rnd` skill in this folder, then the `rnd-pmo` skill, and follow them. Register the product I describe: give it a short kebab-case product key, its owner, and one repository URL per line. Check for an existing product with the same name or key first.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-rnd` Skill，再读 `rnd-pmo` Skill，按它们的流程做。登记我描述的产品：起一个简短的 kebab-case 产品标识，写上负责人，代码仓库一行一个地址。先查有没有同名或同标识的产品。

label.en: Give me the full picture of one product

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-rnd` skill in this folder, then the `rnd-pmo` skill, and follow them. For the product I name, summarise its open projects and their health, what shipped in the last two weeks, what is waiting for acceptance, and the top of its backlog. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-rnd` Skill，再读 `rnd-pmo` Skill，按它们的流程做。针对我说的产品，汇总进行中的项目及健康度、最近两周上线了什么、有什么在等验收、需求池排在最前面的几项。不要修改任何记录。
